build_lexicon_graph: build a graph that transduces letters to word pieces using a lexicon of allowed word pieces
build_token_graph: build a graph with individual token transition models for consuming one or more consecutive word pieces
compose_decomposition_graph: compose a recognition graph with a lexicon graph to compute all possible word decompositions
compute_alignment_graph: compute the alignment graph by composing token and decomposition graphs for sequence alignment
compute_sequence_loss: compute the sequence level loss by intersecting emissions with alignment graphs and scoring forward
